items.excerpt: Everyone talks about AI. Few use it with confidence in there respective fields. This session bridges the gap
items.body:
Everyone talks about AI. Few use it with confidence. This session bridges the gap.



In just 2 hours, we move from foundational tool capabilities — including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Kimi, and DeepSeek — to strict Singapore-aligned regulatory compliance, structured prompting, and a practical preview of vibe coding.



\### What you'll cover



1. \*\*AI Foundations & Landscape (15 mins)\*\* — Demystify AI, ML, DL, and LLMs. Explore the major tools and learn the structured CO-STAR prompting framework.

2. \*\*The AI Generalist Roadmap\*\* — Navigate 6 progressive levels, from basic daily toolkits to advanced multimodal AI, workflow automation, and rapid vibe coding.

3. \*\*Governance, Law & Risk\*\* — A deep dive into Singapore's Gen AI Model Framework, PDPC Advisory Guidelines, vendor checklists, and professional firm risk registers.

4. \*\*Live Demonstrations & Workflows\*\* — Real prompts and real-world tools: automating Schedule III reports, financial dashboards, instant data cleaning, and automated reminders.

5. \*\*Vibe Coding & Your Future\*\* — A practical preview of building bespoke local software tools (like payroll assistants or image slicers) using pure natural language.

6. \*\*Trusted Practice & Professional Duty\*\* — Bridge theory and action: protect client data, guard against IP leakage and hallucinations, and retain ultimate human accountability.



\### Bonus: Exclusive Practical Cheat Sheets Pack



Every participant walks away with 8 practical, ready-to-use resources — from AI content compliance checklists to a 12-gate screening checklist — designed for everyday use and quarterly audits alike.



This is a highly interactive session with live games, quizzes, and prizes — bring your phone!
